conversations.$comment: Played by LevelBase._run_conversation the first time she arrives.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Apo. There you are. I was waiting for you, I think.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Funny. I was never in this one. I do not know how I came to be standing in it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Listen. The brush has what it has, and nothing on this mountain gives any back. Spend it like you mean it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: There was a way across here. We came over it a minute ago. Now look at it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: There. Back where it was. Nearly.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: The path is going thin. Like a word you had on your tongue a moment ago.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Up we go. Your lola would have done the same.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: That is the last of it. Keep climbing.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Careful, apo. Back to where we were.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Apo. Look. Those are ours. Those are -- I know that one. I know all of them.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Not that. Something that was in it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: There is no more ink for that one.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: That one? Nobody needed that one. ... She painted it anyway, didn't she.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: The terraces. I carried your lola down those, once, in the rain. There -- I had lost that.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: We were married in that one. Apo. Your name is -- yes. Apo. I have it again.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: My bangka. I was going to tell you something about the sea. I remember now what it was.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Apo, I -- what was I. I was going to say. I am sorry. I had it a moment ago.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: No. Put it down, apo. The brush was never for that. Your lola knew.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: That is why she painted the places instead. The fiesta, the sea, the house. That is how she kept m

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Your lola and I came up here once, for the -- the. What do you call it. With the dancing. Ha. Old age, apo.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: I had it a moment ago. The name of -- no. It will come back. It always comes back.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: See the fold, apo? Right through her plaza. That was us. ... Did I say that already? I think I said that already.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Lola? Lola, it's me. It's apo.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Your house on the terraces, with the steps up to it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The terraces lolo carried you down, in the rain.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The fiesta flags, all the way across the plaza.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The dancers, and the dress you never let me touch.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The church where you and lolo were married.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The storm, and how it ended.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Lolo's bangka, out on the water.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The reef, in every colour you had.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The deep, and the one that searched it. It was looking for you.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The woods you taught me not to be afraid of.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The falls under the balete.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: And a flower nobody needed. You painted it anyway.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: You noticed everything, Lola. Where the light sat on the water. You made all of it so it would be seen.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: You always found the way through, Lola. Whatever it was, you did the next thing, and then the next.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: You kept us safe, Lola. Every one of us. You took the fear out of those woods for me before I ever walked in them.

lines.speaker: lola
lines.text: Oh -- hello, little one. Do you like it? I think it is nearly finished.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It's beautiful, Lola. I'll stay a while.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: These are for you. One from each of them.

lines.speaker: lola
lines.text: ...Apo? Apo. And your lolo -- we were only just talking about him, weren't we.

lines.speaker: lola
lines.text: Do you like it, little one? I think it is nearly finished.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Lola. Can I tell you about some places?

lines.speaker: lola
lines.text: If you like, dear.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: That is a bahay kubo. Someone lived there who loved you.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There were terraces, green and gold, all the way up.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a fiesta, with flags strung across the plaza.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There were dancers, in a dress you sewed yourself.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a church, and a wedding in it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a storm at sea. It passed.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a bangka, and a man who rowed it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a reef, every colour there is.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a sea with something in it that could not see.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There was a forest at night, and it kept a child safe.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There were falls, under a balete.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: And there was a flower nobody needed. You painted it anyway.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: And there was a man, Lola. You lost him first. Let me tell you about him.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Up here it takes only a sure line.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It knows my hand now.
